p: stricken in years: Being almost a hundred and ten years old.
possessed: After the enemies are overcome.
expelled not the Geshurites: Because they had not destroyed all as God had commanded they that remainder were snares and pricks to hurt them, Nu 33:35; Jos 23:13; Jud 2:3.
their inheritance: Levi will live by the sacrifices, Nu 18:21.
Balaam also the son of Beor: So that both they who obeyed wicked counsel and the wicked counsellor perished by the just judgment of God.
other side Jordan eastward: That is, in the land of Moab.
children of Machir the son of: Meaning, his nephews and posterity.
